interiorPrompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Safety Last, a cute worker co-op survival game in a reclaimed derelict factory. Painterly old-school game art with readable dark edges, warm timber, desaturated teal paint, rust orange iron, reclaimed brick, moderate texture, soft upper-left lighting. Orthographic top-down camera looking slightly from the south, edges parallel to image axes, north wall horizontal, east/west walls vertical. NOT diagonal isometric. Transparent background outside the object; no ground terrain, no people, no words or labels, no watermark. Single large enterable structure, square canvas, centered. This image is the ROOFLESS BASE INTERIOR ONLY. Large rectangular floor and perimeter supports/walls, wide unobstructed south-center entrance. The middle half of the floor and approach to doorway must be clear for several worker characters to walk. All posts and supports near perimeter, no centered pillar. Do not bake furniture, containers, food or tools into the floor; these will be placed separately. Subtle bedroll/cot placement mats at the far side can be empty. Entire object in frame with 8 percent transparent margin. 2D game sprite, same stylized physical materials as rusted teal camp hearths, no tiny photoreal noise. TIER 1 LEAN-TO. Simple large platform made of mismatched salvaged planks, four rough timber posts, rear wall of low salvaged teal factory panels and braces, left/right sides mostly open. NO tarp or roof fabric in this image. Size for four workers: width visually around five worker body widths. Four clear sleeping positions can be added later. Front entrance completely open across central 45 percent of width. Keep it scrappy, functional and recognizably improvised. Plan view floor fills x15%–85%, y22%–84%; timber rear top edges around y15%; ground-contact bottom at y89%.

Keep empty bottom space so overlay aligns with base. No text.
